opinions.text: Motion of the Special Master for award of compensation and reimbursement of expenses granted, and the Special Master is awarded a total of $180,833.83 for the period April 1 through September 30, 1994, to be paid as follows: 30% to be paid by each Nebraska and Wyoming, 15% to be paid by Colorado, and 25% to be paid by the United States. [For earlier order herein, see, e. g., ante, p. 923.]
